subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving selective reply routing to existing message-tool policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed metadata gap is narrow, but choosing a new channel-selective reply API would change channel delivery policy and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope to prompt metadata parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Design selective routing API
options.body: Keep the issue in product design or split a follow-up for new prompt/API semantics around channel-selective replies.

options.title: Close after existing policy docs
options.body: Do not pursue code changes and rely on existing visible-reply/message-tool configuration, accepting that command prompt reconstruction keeps losing runtime channel metadata.

recommendation.title: Scope to prompt metadata parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the shared command prompt bundle and earlier `/context` prompt path, and is the clearest history-backed owner for the scope decision.
